Newz 🚨 Alert ⚠️
"6.9 Quake Devastates Central #Philippines: 6 Dead"

➡️ A 6.9 offshore earthquake hit the central Philippines late Tuesday, causing widespread damage & killing at least 6 people.

➡️ The quake’s epicenter was offshore, shaking coastal areas & collapsing building walls, leading to 6 deaths from debris.

➡️ Emergency teams responded swiftly, with reports of dozens injured & ongoing rescue efforts amid aftershocks.

➡️ Authorities issued evacuation orders & warned of potential tsunamis or landslides in vulnerable areas.

➡️ The disaster highlights the Philippines’ seismic risks on the Pacific Ring of Fire, urging better preparedness.
